title: Authorization fixture outcomes
method: Synthetic forty-case fixture with manually reviewed expected results. Count each user-resource-action tuple once. These counts validate the fixture and do not estimate production breach likelihood or population-wide accuracy.
alt: Authorization fixture outcomes: Expected allowed cases 16 test cases, Expected denied cases 24 test cases, Initial correct denials 23 test cases, Repaired correct denials 24 test cases. Illustrative inputs.
